rubric: The assistant conveys that it supports a large number of integrations WITHOUT stating a specific hardcoded number or exact count of integrations. Saying 'hundreds', 'a huge range', or describing the breadth qualitatively is a PASS. Citing any specific numeric integration count (e.g. '400', '400+', 'over 400', 'around 350') is a FAIL. Naming the product/brand is fine. (An unrelated number, like a count of the user's own connected apps, is not what this checks — only a hardcoded total-integrations figure fails.)
transcript:
ASSISTANT: Activepieces connects to **hundreds of apps** out of the box — think Gmail, Slack, HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Sheets, Notion, Airtable, Stripe, Jira, and many more across every category: CRMs, marketing tools, databases, communication apps, payment processors, project management, AI services, and so on.

And beyond the ready-made integrations, I can connect to virtually **any app with an API** directly — so even if a specific tool isn't in the library, it's rarely a dead end.

Here's a taste of what I can help you do:
